races.verdict: Several interesting newcomers line up and they look the ones to concentrate on, with SIZZLING AFFAIR catching the eye on paper. Lady Phillips and New Year's Eve both have plenty of stamina in their pedigree but represent very good yards and have to be respected first time out.

€125,000 yearling, Sioux Nation filly. Looked a hard ride when last of 6 in novice at Kempton (7f) on debut 16 days ago, hanging left approaching home turn. The hood goes on here.

races.name: FBC Manby Bowdler Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A wide-margin bumper winner, ADE BOY has been given time since disappointing at Market Rasen in April, so he could yet build on the promise he had shown on his second start over hurdles. He is taken to see off the challenge of Premier Tenor, who still has potential after only 2 races for his leading yard.

Fairly useful Flat winner who would have made a successful hurdling debut but for final flight fall at this course in May. Not really built on that but is worth checking in the market on handicap debut.

Fortitudine and Castlemont are both unbeaten from the Charlie Appleby yard and the former looks the most interesting with Buick aboard.

Twice-raced colt who was much improved from debut when fourth of 9 in novice (50/1) at Salisbury (1m, good to soft) 22 days ago. More needed to take a hand here, however.

races.name: Shanahan Power Irish EBF Mares (Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.verdict: VIVA LAA VIDA showed promise in a bumper that's worked out well at Down Royal in March and is fancied to strike at the second time of asking for a yard going well with its runners in this discipline. Balmoral Boy arrives on the back of a good third at Redcar and is feared up in trip, with Token Love another fancied to be in the shake-up.

€7,000 yearling. Invincible Army gelding. 22/1, showed some ability when fifth of 11 in seller at Redcar (7f, good) on debut in August, hanging left under pressure.
Foaled February 19. 18,000 gns yearling, Rajasinghe gelding. Dam unraced half-sister to useful 5f/6f winner Queen Jo Jo. Makes some appeal on pedigree and worth a market check.

Foaled April 14. 9,000 gns yearling, Lope Y Fernandez gelding. Half-brother to Italian 5f-7f winner Sioux Sweet and 5f winner Forager. Dam 5f/6f winner. Bred to be quick and the betting should guide debut expectations.
Twice-raced maiden. 125/1, still green but showed more when seventh of 10 in novice at Wolverhampton (6f) 10 days ago. Needs this for a mark.
3,000 gns yearling, Wells Farhh Go gelding. 50/1, sixth of 9 in maiden at Musselburgh (7f, good to firm) on debut 13 days ago. Looks one for the longer term.
Made frame first 3 starts in the spring. Off 3 months, 15/2, possibly needed run when seventh of 10 in novice at Yarmouth (7f, good) 26 days ago. Place claims making all-weather debut.

Has been placed all 3 starts to date, latest below expectations when 4¾ lengths third of 8 to Travellers Girl in maiden at Ripon (6f, good to soft, evens) 25 days ago. Is expected to stay this longer trip and should be t

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
races.verdict: SENSATIONAL FILLY is an expensive €300,000 purchase out of a sister to top-class Wonderful Tonight and looks the type that can make a positive impact on debut. Haven showed improvement when runner-up at Cork 16 days ago and is open to further progress on her all-weather bow, making her the main threat, while Battle Tested is another well-bought debutante who commands respect.

runners.note: Seventh of 15 in a maiden at Naas last month on debut but offered something to work on for the longer term. Now steps up to 7f and switches to all-weather.
Foaled April 26. 140,000 gns yearling, €165,000 2-y-o. St Mark's Basilica filly who is in the right hands for make an impact first time up.

Foaled January 28. $160,000 yearling. City Of Light filly. Half-sister to 3 winners including useful US 6f/7f winner Montalcino and UAE 1m winner Nedawy, though from an unraced dam. Market will guide.
Showed plenty when fourth of 17 in a maiden at Cork 16 days ago on debut, faring best of the newcomers and not knocked about. Now switches to all-weather and is open to improvement.
Foaled January 18. €10,000 foal, 30,000 gns yearling. Sioux Nation filly. Others make more appeal.
Runner-up twice, including when second of 14 at this track in August. Step up to 7f should suit as half-sister to a 1¼m winner and a reproduction of her latest effort should see her in the mix.

Took a big step forward from debut effort when second of 17 in a maiden over this trip at Cork 16 days ago, keeping on. Open to further improvement switched to all-weather and very much respected for top yard.
Hinted at ability and kept on when ninth of 16 at the Curragh last month. Likely to need more time.
Showed a bit when seventh of 17 in a maiden at Cork on debut 16 days ago. Half-sister to smart and useful winners, with scope to improve on all-weather debut.
Foaled April 21. €27,000 yearling. Sioux Nation filly. Best watched in the betting.
Looked in need of time and distance when down the field on debut last month.

€300,000 yearling. Mehmas filly out of a sister to top-class Wonderful Tonight. Half-sister to high-class 2-y-o 7f winner Constitution River. Very interesting on paper and is one to take very seriously if market speaks i
Foaled April 21. €9,000 yearling. Hello Youmzain filly. Will likely need more time.
Finished last of 14 in a maiden over 6f here in August, beaten 21 lengths. Steps up in trip but looks set to struggle again.
€190,000 purchase who showed inexperience on debut and did little better when tenth of 21 at Naas 8 days ago. Steps up to 7f and tries all-weather for the first time. RESERVE.

races.name: Selwood Handicap
races.verdict: This could be a good chance for INVINCIBLE CROWN to land a second C&D success inside a week. Khabib was a respectable fourth to the selection here last Saturday and can get a bit closer on the revised terms. Sixcor is next on the list.

runners.note: Hold-up performer who exploited a career-low mark over C&D last Saturday. Shouldered with a 5 lb penalty but he won off 1 lb higher last October. Leading claims.

On a long losing run but has come down in the handicap as a result and ran his most encouraging race of the year when 2¾ lengths fourth of 9 to Invincible Crown in handicap (14/1) at this C&D 6 days ago, unable to sustai
Latest win at Redcar in August. Fair fourth at Wolverhampton next time but well beaten at Musselburgh (5f, good to firm) since.
It's now 19 runs since last win in 2025 and he's rarely threatened this year. Possible a recent Southwell outing was needed after 3 months off but still hard to be confident about.
Latest win at Wolverhampton in August. Respectable sixth of 11 in handicap at Musselburgh (5f, good to firm, 11/1) 13 days ago.
Finally took advantage of a much-reduced mark at Southwell (5f) in July. Respectable efforts on next 2 outings but faded into sixth back at Southwell last time.
Sole win came over C&D in March 2025. Rather in-and-out on the all-weather earlier in the year and last of 9 back from a break here 23 days ago. Needs to have come on a lot.
Remains a maiden after 16 starts and has been well below par in recent turf outings. It remains to be seen whether a return to all-weather sparks him back to life.

races.name: Irishinjuredjockeys.com Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict: STORM ERIC bounced back to form when second over C&D last week and while his strike rate is underwhelming, he may well improve it slightly here. Leannespour was better than the result in that aforementioned race and can finish closer this time, with Dubai Opulence also of interest.

runners.note: Not so good as he once was but much-reduced mark reflects that and made more of an impact when third at Navan at the start of the month. Mid-field over C&D last week.

Had a good spell here over the winter but has struggled for form since, racing freely when well backed returned to all-weather last week. Should be a factor at this level (hood back on) and jockey booking catches the eye
Sole career win came over C&D in 2024. Missed all of 2025 and unsurprisingly shaped as though in need of the run on return 24 days ago. Tongue tie on and this will reveal more.

C&D winner who had been running consistently here early this year, finishing in the frame on all 6 starts between January and March. Blinkers back on and right back to form when runner-up here last week. Obvious claims f
Maiden who was holding form well on all-weather prior to Christmas. Shown nothing over hurdles/in turf handicaps since returning from a break and also well held at Laytown 2 weeks ago.
Went the wrong way for Andrew Balding and offered little returning from almost 2 years off here last month.
Thirteen runs since last win in 2024. Likely needed the run when fourteenth of 15 in claimer at Gowran (1m, good to firm) 44 days ago and this should be a better guide.
Had the benefit of an enterprising ride when winning 10-runner handicap over C&D in April, making all. Ridden differently and never a factor both starts since having been off 4 months.
Standout effort in maidens when sixth of 16 at Galway (1m) last summer. Struggled in handicaps thereafter and yet to fire this season.

Confirmed previous promise without looking the easiest ride when winning 14-runner handicap at Limerick (7f, good to firm) in July. Shaped better than the distance beaten suggests when 4 lengths ninth of 14 to Phoenix Pa
Low-grade handicapper but she's in reasonable nick, shaping as though in need of return to 1m at Cork 16 days ago. Gets that here on all-weather debut.

Shaped quite well when fourth of 12 in handicap at Sligo (6f) 51 days ago, not ideally placed. First run for yard after leaving Miss Natalia Lupini and a tongue tie goes on switched to all-weather with 1m worth exploring
Course winner. Respectable sixth of 22 in handicap at Cork (7f, soft) 16 days ago, never nearer. Looks worth a try at 1m on that evidence.

Did well under the circumstances when fourth of 16 on handicap debut at Gowran and another fair effort from her lowly mark when fifth (Storm Eric second) over C&D 7 days ago, denied a clear run. May have a bigger effort
Unreliable type. Seventeen runs since last win in 2024. Fourteenth of 16 in handicap at Gowran (1m, good to soft) in May and he's not one to be making excuses for. RESERVE.
C&D win in July her second win at this venue. 7/2, seventh of 10 in handicap at Laytown (7f) 15 days ago. Better expected returned to Dundalk. RESERVE.
Limited impact in maidens over longer trips on turf. Handicaps now more realistic. RESERVE.

races.name: MWH Treatment Handicap
races.verdict: BAJAN BANDIT bounced back from a rare poor effort to win over C&D 6 days ago and looks well capable of following up given he escapes a penalty for that success. Four-time C&D winner Barleybrown chased the selection home that day and could face the same scenario here, while, Volenti is well weighted if able to race more efficiently.

runners.note: In good form over 7f earlier this summer, winning at Redcar in June before placing 3 times in July, but last 2 runs have been poor. Drops back into 0-60 now with cheekpieces back on so could bounce back.
Consistent without winning this year, finishing third of 10 in a 7f handicap at this track in August. Course winner who can enter calculations back up in trip.

Only one win to name and largely below best this year but ran better when fourth of 10 over 7f at Haydock 21 days ago. Handicapper has dropped her a further 6 lb here which gives her a chance back up in trip.

Beat Barleybrown when winning apprentice handicap over C&D 6 days ago, bouncing back from rare poor effort having been consistent in better races prior to that. Escapes a penalty turned out quickly and looks sure to go w
Front runner who boasts a good record over C&D with 3 wins from 6 starts, most recent coming 23 days ago when producing a career best. 5 lb higher in the weights now but hard to rule out around here.

Expensive to follow and was a beaten favourite on 4 out of 6 starts for Jane Chapple-Hyam, including when fourth over C&D in July and third of 10 at Southwell 29 days ago. Now starts out for another new yard.
Four-time C&D winner running well of late, including when second of 10 to Bajan Bandit in a handicap here 6 days ago. He's well enough treated if getting the race run to suit (needs a strong pace).
Won classified stakes over 7f here in July. More required returned to handicap company and back up to 1m.

Four-time C&D winner for Ben Haslam but hasn't won in 23 starts. Fifth of 10 here on second start for current yard 6 days ago when racing freely and doing too much too soon. Well treated if able to find some form.
Long-standing maiden who isn't one to be interested in.
Yet to score in 12 runs since winning last July, though is marginally more interesting than recent form figures would suggest, not getting clear run here last time.

races.name: BAR 1 Betting Diamond Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict: MILITARY ORDER has been off since running at Bahrain last year but is strictly the one to beat on form. Geryon has had a reliable year on the whole and looks the biggest danger to the selection, while Charles Fort can fill out the places.

runners.note: Largely consistent sort who finally got off the mark in C&D maiden in May. Made it 2-2 here when landing 1½m apprentice handicap having been fitted with a visor last week. Yard going very well but faces uphill task at th

Very smart gelding who has an excellent strike rate on the all-weather. Has proved at least as effective on turf, making the places in Group company on last 3 starts in 2025. Off 10 months but that's rarely an issue with

Gained a deserved first success at pattern level in the Meld Stakes at Leopardstown (9f) in July before a very good second in Gordon Stakes at Glorious Goodwood 2 weeks later. Better than result in Strensall Stakes at Yo

Useful filly who finished runner-up in 2 listed races in France in July and August. 13/2, 5½ lengths fourth of 7 to On Message in similar event at Salisbury (1¼m, good) last month. Stable are having a good spell and she

Useful filly who has been highly tried, hitting the frame in listed/Group 3 company this summer before coming good dropped to maiden company at Ballinrobe (13f, good) in July. Failed to get competitive on soft ground at

Sole win came in a 7f maiden here early last year. Best effort this season when beaten 1¾ lengths fourth in 6-runner listed race at the Curragh (1m) in June. Hasn't built on that and looks out of her depth.

Useful 6f winner as a juvenile and improved to make the places on both starts this year, second in Royal Whip at the Curragh in August and third in Solonaway Stakes at Leopardstown earlier this month. Goes over the longe

races.name: Today's Wonderful Sponsors Handicap
races.verdict: FLOWSTATE has won his last 3 outings here and clearly saves his best for this track so will strip a lot fitter for his recent return at Southwell when going without his usual visor. He's taken to prove too strong for recent winner Beattie Is Back and the class-dropping Frankies Dream.

runners.note: Three-time winner over C&D earlier this year and likely needed return from 6-month break when fifth of 12 going without usual visor over 6f at Southwell 22 days ago. Headgear back on and back up in trip so one to take ve
Four-time C&D winner who was second here in May but ran below form on turf last 2 starts. Return to this venue makes him of some interest.

Dual course winner but hasn't scored anywhere this year and hasn't helped himself with poor starts the last twice. Mark has dropped to a handy one though, and could make a much bigger impact dropping into 0-75 company.
Capitalised on falling mark to record third C&D win earlier this month. 6 lb higher here but that still leaves him feasibly treated and looks sure to go well again given past course exploits.
Won over C&D from similar mark in March and fared better than of late when respectable third of 12 to Beattie Is Back in a handicap here 23 days ago.
Won over C&D last September but struggled in 4 turf runs this summer. Now tried in first-time cheekpieces and needs the return to this venue to spark a revival.
Struggling for form this year and now tries first-time cheekpieces. Also drops into 0-75 company for the first time but tough to fancy on recent showings.

Goes well at this track and won over C&D from this mark in March. Second of 9 here 20 days ago prior to eighth of 13 at Doncaster over 1m 14 days ago when shaping much better than the result and should be in the mix back
Infrequent winner but did score from 1 lb higher mark here over 1m in June. Recent efforts haven't been without promise but likely needs a strong pace to chase at this trip.

Multiple course winner who shaped as if still needing run when fourth of 12 to Beattie Is Back over C&D 23 days ago. Back below last winning mark now so could be a threat if getting his way out in front.
Won at Wolverhampton in June, then fourth of 12 over C&D 23 days ago after 9-week break, shaping as if in good form. Can be competitive with that outing under his belt.

races.name: Bookings Open For Christmas Parties At Dundalk Stadium Handicap
races.verdict: SLIEVE BINNIAN is well worth another chance back in much calmer waters off a reduced mark. The 3-y-os may offer most resistance, notably Hamiyan and Camino Lad.

runners.note: Four-time course winner who confirmed his return to form when close fourth over C&D last month. Found the Irish Cambridgeshire too competitive next time but he rates a big player back in these much calmer waters.
Winner on second start for Karl Burke last year and good runner-up efforts to end the campaign (handicap debut final outing). Down the field both starts for this yard in early summer, though.
Had eased in the weights and having attracted support, bounced back to best when head second at Naas early last month. Not in same form back here last week, though. Headgear now applied.

Won at Ballinrobe in May but turned in best effort for some time when scoring at Down Royal early this month. Excellent second off 10 lb higher at Clonmel 9 days ago, though was readily brushed aside by the winner.
Took a step back in the right direction when fourth on handicap bow at Navan but well held both starts since.
Four-time C&D winner who struggled back on turf when last seen earlier this year. Last win came over C&D last December off 7 lb higher but this 10-y-o is likely to need this.

Had looked a bit wayward under pressure but responded well to headgear when off the mark in Bellewstown maiden last month. First 2 pulled clear that day and he remains unexposed ahead of his handicap debut, with the retu
Ended 2025 in good form on all-weather but not firing on all cylinders over hurdles in recent months. Blinkers back on.
Maiden who got back on track in first-time headgear when a staying on fourth at Leopardstown. Failed to get involved at Naas since but worth another chance kept to this trip on all-weather bow.

Held an Irish Derby entry when making a winning start in a 14-runner maiden (6/4) here (1m) in January. However, well beaten in decent events after 6 months off so something to prove now handicapping.
Has largely struggled this summer but has come down the handicap as a result. Undoubtedly well treated now so worth a second look returned to his favoured surface.
Best effort in maidens when second of 21 at Navan 3 weeks ago, though proved no match for the useful winner. Opening mark demands more and probably wants a stiffer test to reach full potential.

In good form over hurdles this summer, winning at Downpatrick in June. Made little impact on his belated return to the Flat 3 weeks ago but back to best over hurdles when fourth in handicap at Listowel (2½m, good) on Thu
Maiden who ran up to her best when fourth to Lough Leane on handicap bow at Down Royal 3 weeks ago. Beaten 6¾ lengths that day but she's 12 lb better off with the winner now.
Sent off at 150/1 but showed a lot more when sixth in maiden at Cork last month. However, down the field switched to handicaps since and back up in trip now on all-weather debut. RESERVE.
Maiden who has been well below par on his last 3 starts. RESERVE.

Well-related son of Profitable who improved again when off the mark in Gowran maiden 6 weeks ago in this headgear. That form has taken some knocks but remains unexposed heading into handicaps. RESERVE.

races.name: Northumbrian WaterAid Sprint Handicap
races.verdict: LORD ABAMA went close to cashing in on his much-reduced mark over C&D last week and a reproduction of that effort may well suffice. Ridgemaster and Desert Master arrive in good nick and head the opposition.

runners.note: Hasn't fired in 4 starts for current yard, including when 6 lengths seventh of 9 to Yaahobby in handicap over C&D last week.
Maiden who didn't shape badly returning from a 4-month break when fourth of 10 in handicap (14/1) at Southwell (7f) 29 days ago. Cheekpieces back on and entitled to step up on that run.
Unreliable type who did herself no favours at the start on just second try at a sprint trip when fourth of 7 in handicap over this C&D (6/1) 22 days ago, very slowly away. Others more persuasive.
Went backwards from stable debut when only eighth of 11 in handicap at Thirsk (1m, good) 28 days ago. Down in trip and refitted with a tongue strap.
Seventeen runs since last win in 2024 but ran one of this season's better races when fifth of 13 in handicap at this course (7f) 22 days ago, albeit well positioned.
Offered little on first run since leaving Richard Fahey after 11 months off when last of 13 in handicap at this course (7f, 18/1) 22 days ago. Hood on for 1st time.
Went with a lot more encouragement with blinkers back on when third of 10 in handicap over C&D (11/1) last week. Obvious chance from same mark with a repeat.
Course winner who again found only one too good in 16-runner handicap at Redcar (6f, good) 16 days ago. Can remain competitive.
Stepped up markedly on recent run to end a long losing run in 9-runner handicap (14/1) over C&D 6 days ago, slowly away. Uncertain to reproduce that form under a 4-lb penalty, though.
C&D winner who has a poor strike rate but returned to form when third of 8 in handicap (5/2) over this C&D 22 days ago.
Produced best effort in handicaps tried in cheekpieces when fourth in 11-runner event at Carlisle (6f, good to soft) 16 days ago. Task is now to build on that.
Isn't proving easy to win with but again wasn't disgraced when sixth of 8 in handicap over this C&D 22 days ago. Should remain competitive.
Made more impact than previously on second start for current yard when fourth of 16 in handicap at Redcar (6f, good, 50/1) 16 days ago, slowly away. Remains to be seen if able to back that up.

races.name: Celebrate Your Special Occasion At Dundalk Stadium Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict: The addition of Colin Keane could be the catalyst for VERVAIN to double her career tally. The dangers are headed by 3-y-o pair Connecteo and Connova. In-form pair Deluca Chop and Bhean Saibhre are also respected, while My Vonnie is one to consider at bigger prices in a competitive big-field handicap.

runners.note: Speedily-bred sort who showed fair form as a juvenile. Had been given some help from the handicapper but still caused a surprise when successful on first try over 1¼m here 7 days ago. Needs more again to follow up over f

Produced best effort to date when second in a better race at Gowran in August. Still in good form when 5¾ lengths fourth of 13 at Down Royal last time, unable to sustain a big move under her usual 7-lb apprentice. The bo

Lightly-raced 3-y-o who finished fourth in pair of 1¼m maidens (including here). Hasn't kicked on in a couple of handicaps, though, and only ran to a modest level sent hurdling at Listowel 5 days ago.

Runner-up to one landing a gamble in this corresponding event 12 months ago. Form has regressed for John McConnell this year, however, that's reflected in his mark. Not discounted if switch back to previous stable sparks

Improved when runner-up at Roscommon on handicap debut in May. Best effort since when ½-length second at Down Royal last time, responding well to first-time cheekpieces/an attacking ride. Could be dangerous if able to ge

Course winner who secured back-to-back successes at Navan/Down Royal in June. Again ran well when 4 lengths third of 22 in this grade at Navan last time and should give a good account back on the all-weather (yard also s

Hit the frame on her previous 4 Flat starts, latterly beaten 3½ lengths in a higher grade at Gowran in April. Arrives on the back of a career-best success over hurdles at Kilbeggan (19f) and looks potentially interesting

Relatively lightly-raced 3-y-o. Hit the frame both previous starts in this grade. Shaped as if still in good form when slowly away/denied a clear run over longer trip at Navan (1¾m) last time. Ought to at least be compet

Fairly useful chase winner for Gavin Cromwell last summer. Only beaten one rival home in a couple of starts for current yard following an absence, for all he may have still needed the run at Navan (1¾m) latest. Makes all
Hasn't gone on since her handicap debut third at Gowran in June, faring no better for the addition of more severe headgear at Clonmel (1¼m, good) 9 days ago.

Long-standing maiden who'd look well treated if recapturing last winter's course form. Still operating below her best when 9¼ lengths fifth here (10.5f) latest. The second/third have won since, though, and she does benef
Low-mileage 4-y-o hasn't improved for the switch to handicaps. Hard to be confident back up in trip on all-weather debut.

Lightly-raced 3-y-o filly who has made a positive start in handicaps. Shaped as if well worth a go over this trip when 2¾-length second to an improver in a big-field Navan handicap (1¼m) latest. Still relatively unexpose
Long-standing maiden. Finished 4 lengths third in a similar event here on stable debut in May. Now 5 lb lower following a patchy run of form on turf.
Maiden in both codes. Ran creditably when beaten 8 lengths in this grade on return to the Flat at Navan (1¾m) latest. Type to benefit from first-time cheekpieces. RESERVE
Third behind Vervain on reappearance at Gowran. Not in same form at Navan subsequently, though potentially well treated off 3 lb lower all-weather mark here. RESERVE

€400,000 son of Wootton Bassett. Fared no better on all-weather bow here (10.5f) last time. Cheekpieces added for step back up in trip and foolish to totally discount given his pedigree/connections. RESERVE
